title: Northloop Payments Seller Terms: The On-Demand Payout and Its Amount
content:
**Terms.** On a plan that allows on-demand payouts the seller may request one on-demand payout to the bank account on file when at least the on-demand interval has passed since the last on-demand payout. The on-demand payout is the on-demand payable amount, capped at the plan's maximum per payout and rounded to the cent. The on-demand payable amount is the balance less the reserved balance as they stand when the payout is requested.

## Conditions of a request

| The seller's payout plan | Time since the last on-demand payout | One on-demand payout may be requested |
|---|---|---|
| allows on-demand payouts | at least the plan's on-demand interval | yes |
| allows on-demand payouts | less than the interval | no |
| does not allow on-demand payouts | — | no |

## Amount

| Quantity | Reading |
|---|---|
| Balance and reserved balance | as they stand on the Northloop Payments account when the payout is requested |
| On-demand payable amount | the balance less the reserved balance |
| Cap | the payout plan's maximum per payout |
| Rounding | to the cent |

## Hypothetical worked examples

- *Payments Weekly (interval 24 hours; maximum per payout 50000.00 USD).* Balance 12000.00 USD, reserved 2500.00 USD: the on-demand payable amount is 9500.00 USD, below the cap, so the on-demand payout is 9500.00 USD.
- *Payments Biweekly, balance 81000.00 USD, reserved 6000.00 USD.* The payable amount of 75000.00 USD is above the 50000.00 USD cap, so the on-demand payout is 50000.00 USD.
- *Interval boundary, 24-hour plan.* A request exactly 24 hours after the last on-demand payout has waited at least the interval and may be made; a request 23 hours after it may not.
- *Payments Starter.* The plan does not allow on-demand payouts.
